2) Whether BrightCart prefers the charge to run through Azure Marketplace private offer (managed billing) or direct invoicing.
3) Procurement timeline / PO cadence and any legal redlines (we can loop in our contracts team).

- Sarah to share a recent usage export (monthly token counts) — you mentioned Q3 export.

Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace Private Offer - Unit Price Mapping & $/1M tokens

Thanks for the upload, Sarah — good data. A few notes on mapping and Marketplace mechanics (aiming to keep this concise):

1) Marketplace surcharge vs unit price
- Marketplace private offers on Azure typically allow the seller (us) to set a single unit price that the buyer sees. Azure will retain a marketplace fee as part of their billing settlement. Practically, there are two ways we model it:
  a) List a public-facing unit price that already includes an expected Azure surcharge (easier for procurement).
  b) Keep unit price net to Redwood and have Azure add a marketplace fee line item (cleaner accounting for us, sometimes messy for procurement).
- For BrightCart’s target ($850–$950 / 1M tokens), option (a) is usually what procurement prefers since it simplifies approvals. We can model a blended unit price that hits your target inclusive of the expected Azure cut.

2) Suggested unit price mapping (initial proposal) — target net $900/1M tokens (BrightCart target mid-point)
- 0–500M tokens: $1,200 / 1M tokens
- 500M–2B tokens: $950 / 1M tokens
- 2B+ tokens: $850 / 1M tokens

This mapping assumes we absorb/estimate a ~10–12% marketplace fee in the listed price for the 500M–2B and 2B+ bands so your net to BrightCart is roughly in the $850–$950 window. Exact numbers depend on Azure’s fee schedule for private offers in your region — I’ll confirm.

3) Billing flow and procurement items we’ll need
- Marketplace private offer: BrightCart needs to accept the private offer in the Azure portal; procurement typically requests a PO + acceptance screenshot for their records.
- For direct invoice: we’d need a master services agreement + billing contact + billing address.

4) Next steps
- Marissa: can we set a 30-minute call on Thursday with BrightCart procurement + our Azure marketplace specialist (Lukas) to confirm acceptance flow and timeline?
- I’ll also pull the expected Azure marketplace fee for private offers (region-specific) and share a short calc sheet.

Links: Azure private offers docs: https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/marketplace/private-offers

Aditya
